name: pollux
hash_encoding: ASCII uppercase decoded text, including recovered word spaces
note: The source key is printed in order 1 through 9 then 0; the stored key is reordered to 0 through 9. The literal published ciphertext decodes to LUCK HELPS. The prose sentence's period is absent from its Morse stream; the ciphertext period is framing, accepted only with an explicit option. This is supplied-map decryption, not an unknown-map attack, unknown-script reading, or new historical decipherment.
